entries.description: Download a song right from where you save it

changelog.title: New
items: Tap the plus in the mini player and you can now download the song from the same place you pick its playlists
The download keeps going after you close it, and shows its progress there whenever you open it again

entries.description: Save a song to any playlist from the mini player, and smoother sheets everywhere

changelog.title: New
items: Tap the plus in the mini player to save the song to Liked songs and pick more playlists, just like Spotify
The plus turns into a tick once the song is saved. Tap the tick to add it to other playlists or remove it
Make a new playlist right there while saving a song
Songs you stream can go into playlists without downloading them first

changelog.title: Improved
items: Every sheet and menu follows your finger, with a soft stretch at the top and a quick settle when you let go
Pull the playlist picker up for the full list, or pull it down to close
The updates menu can be swiped away, and the side menu closes at the speed you throw it

entries.description: A quicker, smoother app on every phone

changelog.title: Improved
items: LuvLyrics opens faster, especially the first few times after an update
Screens redraw less while music plays, so scrolling and the player feel smoother
Animations and swipes are steadier on Android

entries.description: A cleaner player slide, a steadier return to the app, and tidier lyric defaults

changelog.title: Fixed
items: Opening and closing the player is now a clean slide. The cover no longer jumps across the screen
Coming back to the app keeps your place and shows Play, instead of a retry button
Tapping a song after reopening the app plays it straight away
Import and Blend pages now have the same soft cover glow as the rest of the app, with no stray coloured band

changelog.title: Improved
items: The Import page now explains both ways to bring your Spotify music
New installs and Reset now start lyrics at size 24, line by line, with tight spacing
New playlist and Import from Spotify are now in the Library menu (the three dots), so the playlists page is cleaner
